dispositionTable.bullet: L1 order-flow imbalance from limit additions, cancellations, executions
dispositionTable.reason: Cont-style L1 transition law is fully supported by bookTicker-shaped L1
snapshot-differenced band flow, not event-level flow; public diff-depth and snapshots cannot separate cancellations from executions without event-level L2 semantics and a faithful trade join

dispositionTable.bullet: queue imbalance by level and cumulative bands
dispositionTable.reason: L1 and cumulative band imbalances are exactly computable from ladders

dispositionTable.bullet: depth-weighted microprice and displacement from mid
dispositionTable.reason: exact rational microprice displacement from L1 sizes

dispositionTable.bullet: signed trade/aggressor imbalance using exchange maker flags
dispositionTable.reason: aggTrades maker flags give exact aggressor sides

dispositionTable.bullet: trade-arrival rate, acceleration, burstiness, inter-arrival, entropy
dispositionTable.reason: arrival rate and the inter-arrival index of dispersion implemented; acceleration/entropy variants deferred pending binning definitions that survive review

dispositionTable.bullet: trade-size distribution shifts, tail mass, clustering, concentration
dispositionTable.reason: concentration (HHI) implemented; distribution-shift and tail metrics deferred pending reference-window definitions
exact OLS slope imbalance implemented; convexity deferred pending a curvature definition that is stable on five-level bands

dispositionTable.bullet: depth depletion, replenishment, resiliency and migration
dispositionTable.reason: depletion/replenishment/resiliency implemented on snapshot cadence; level-migration tracking deferred

dispositionTable.bullet: cancellation/addition intensity where reconstructable from L2
dispositionTable.reason: public diff-depth and snapshots cannot separate cancellations from executions without event-level L2 semantics and a faithful trade join

dispositionTable.bullet: repeated level interaction and wall persistence
dispositionTable.reason: level-lifetime tracking across snapshots is definable but unvalidated; deferred until a persistence definition earns adoption

dispositionTable.bullet: effective spread and intended-size executable VWAP
dispositionTable.reason: both are exactly computable from joined trades and ladders

dispositionTable.bullet: price response per unit signed flow
dispositionTable.reason: exact OLS mid-response slope over joined trades

dispositionTable.bullet: local impact/Kyle-style slope and Amihud-style illiquidity
dispositionTable.reason: Kyle-style slope and per-volume absolute return are supported

dispositionTable.bullet: absorption proxies: aggressive flow with limited adverse response
dispositionTable.reason: versioned parameterized proxy; replenishment linkage is indirect on snapshot cadence

dispositionTable.bullet: failed breakout/breakdown and failed response features
dispositionTable.reason: requires event/label joins with the Q05 factory; deferred to the phase that wires features to labeled events
opportunity decay exists as a Q05 outcome; a pre-cutoff feature version needs a definition that provably avoids label leakage
